content:
elena-cs: Heads-up — Catalyst dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 11:30 PT. Need final quota confirmation, autoscale policy signoff, and one coordinated load test window. Renewal flagged (customer saw latency spikes in pilot) so we should capture risks and action items. @tom-infra can you confirm region and GPU reservation?

tom-infra: Reserved 4x A100s per pool in us-west-2. Quota itself is OK but burst headroom isn't committed yet. I can add burst capacity of +2 nodes if CS wants it for the smoke. Linking quota sheet: https://docs.internal/quota/catalyst (read-only)

ravi-sre: Proposed autoscale policy: min=2, max=8, scale_step=1, target_gpu_util=0.60. Cost-wise I'd push target to 0.65 but risk tighter latency under spikes. Also need graceful cooldown to avoid flapping.

anya-ml: For load tests, please disable prefix/KV caching and use cold cache runs to surface real behavior. We'll run eval sets pre/post to check quality regressions.

priya-cust: Customer ops requested the test at 11:30 PT (off-peak). They expect 2 engineers on call. SLO requirement reiterated: p99 < 120ms for typical prompts.

tom-infra: 11:30 works. I'll pre-pull images at 11:00 and open the test CIDR. KMS keys are provisioned — @elena-cs can you confirm Catalyst has the IAM role to decrypt?

elena-cs: IAM role shared earlier, but I'll re-confirm and drop names here before the run. Also adding a renewal-risk note to the account: prior pilot had 15% error spike during high concurrency. We should capture any repeat and remediate quickly.

ravi-sre: Loadgen command we'll use (copyable):
```
loadgen --target https://catalyst.redwood/api/v1/generate --qps=300 --duration=1200 --workers=24 --payload-file=prompt_set_v3.json
```
We'll start with a 10m ramp, 20m steady, then 30m soak at 75% QPS if autoscale looks healthy.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: warm images to us-west-2 at 11:00 PT. CI checks passed, no config drift detected.

anya-ml: Please tag the prompts with eval label `catalyst-core-v3` so I can run the automated post-run eval and surface deltas. If we see >2% quality regression on the eval set, we hold rollouts.

tom-infra: I'll add the autoscale blob to the pool config now: `autoscale: {min:2,max:8,target_gpu:0.65,cooldown:300}` and enable model-fallback to the 8-bit variant on OOM.

ravi-sre: I'll own monitoring. Dashboards: token throughput, p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rate, GPU mem pressure, queue depth. Alert if 5m error rate > 2% or p99 > 200ms.

elena-cs: Action items recap: Tom — confirm burst headroom and commit +2 nodes as optional; Ravi — create dashboards + alerts; Anya — prep eval runs and tag prompts; Priya — confirm customer on-call list. I'll prepare the post-test remediation template if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

priya-cust: Confirmed 11:30 PT, 2 engineers on call from Catalyst. They'll share a direct Slack channel if we need real-time troubleshooting.

ravi-sre: After the primary ramp, we'll run a 30-minute soak at 75% QPS to validate hysteresis and scale-down behaviour. I'll capture traces for any p99 outliers.

tom-infra: Infra good to go. Pre-warm and firewall rule scheduled. Ping me if you want to increase QPS mid-test.

elena-cs: Thanks all — runbook link for reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-onboard (please follow checklist). Closing this check-in unless blockers arise.
